boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Regis traditions spanning welcome rituals, annual Ranger celebrations, winter programming and community gatherings.

cards.title: Ranger Week
cards.subtitle: Annual Regis Ranger celebration
cards.notes: Check the Student Activities calendar for the student-organized theme, then join the daytime music, food and activity programming.
cards.short_summary: A long-running, student-shaped week that closes with a day of food, music and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis says Ranger Week has been celebrated for more than 50 years; students organize its theme and entertainment each year.
cards.access_notes: Consult the Student Activities calendar for the current schedule and participation details.

cards.title: Snow Week
cards.subtitle: Regis winter festival
cards.notes: Watch for the late-fall schedule, dress for outdoor activities and choose the snow-themed events that fit your comfort level.
cards.short_summary: A pre-finals winter festival that includes snow-themed programming and ends with the Snow Ball.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis describes Snow Week as a winter festival held between mid-November and early December, ending with the Snow Ball.
cards.access_notes: Dates and individual event arrangements vary; check Student Activities announcements.

cards.title: Christmas Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: Annual on-campus holiday gathering
cards.notes: Look for the holiday announcement, arrive for the caroling and hot chocolate, and enjoy the tree-light reveal with the community.
cards.short_summary: A campus holiday gathering built around caroling, hot chocolate and the annual tree reveal.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis lists an annual Christmas Tree Lighting with hot chocolate, caroling and an on-campus tree-light reveal.
cards.access_notes: Check Student Activities announcements for the annual date and location.

cards.title: First-Year Class Photo
cards.subtitle: Beginning-of-year class record
cards.notes: Join your incoming class when the photo is scheduled and save the official image as a marker of the start of your Regis years.
cards.short_summary: An annual first-year photo intended to give students a shared before-and-after record of college.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis states that it takes a first-year student class photo at the beginning of every year.
cards.access_notes: Timing and download availability are announced by Student Activities.

cards.title: Fall Convocation
cards.subtitle: First-year welcome ceremony
cards.notes: Attend with your first-year cohort and add your name to the community ledger during this formal start-of-year welcome.
cards.short_summary: A beginning-of-college ritual where new students officially enter the Regis community ledger.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis says Fall Convocation welcomes new members and gives them an opportunity to sign their names into the community ledger.
cards.source_title: First Year Learning Community | Regis University
cards.access_notes: This is part of the First Year Experience; follow FYE communications for ceremony details.

cards.title: The World Café
cards.subtitle: First-year dialogue gathering
cards.notes: Bring a question or perspective, listen actively and use the conversation format to engage thoughtfully with fellow community members.
cards.short_summary: A First Year Experience dialogue practice designed for conversations that matter.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis identifies the World Café as a method for engaging conversations that matter and building thoughtful, active listening.
cards.source_title: First Year Learning Community | Regis University
cards.access_notes: Participation details are provided through First Year Experience programming.

cards.title: Winter Welcome
cards.subtitle: January return-to-campus ceremony
cards.notes: Return after winter break for this first-year welcome, then recognize student achievements and the faculty supporting the experience.
cards.short_summary: A January gathering that welcomes newer students back and recognizes academic accomplishment.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis says Winter Welcome gathers the community in January, honors student voices and success, and recognizes Eloquentia Perfecta finalists and first-semester Dean’s List recipients.
cards.source_title: First Year Learning Community | Regis University
cards.access_notes: This First Year Experience event occurs in January; consult FYE updates for the current plan.

cards.title: Blessing and Sending
cards.subtitle: New-student orientation gathering
cards.notes: If it fits your orientation schedule, pause with the incoming class for reflection and encouragement at the start of your Regis journey.
cards.short_summary: An orientation gathering that marks new students’ arrival with reflection and a communal send-off.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis calls Blessing and Sending an orientation tradition rooted in Jesuit values and welcomes students of all backgrounds and beliefs.
cards.access_notes: It is scheduled within SOAR orientation; confirm time and location in the current student schedule.

cards.title: Thursday Thrills
cards.subtitle: Weekly student programming
cards.notes: Check weekly programming notices and bring a friend for the campus gathering; formats can change with the student programming calendar.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Thursday gathering remembered by alumni and identified in current campus programming materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis University’s student-government constitution assigns planning and hosting weekly Thursday Thrills to its programming leadership.
cards.source_title: Constitution of the Regis University Student Government Association
cards.access_notes: The constitution describes Thursday Thrills as weekly and open to the student body; verify the current event listing.

cards.title: Ranger Day
cards.subtitle: Regis student-programming tradition
cards.notes: Follow Student Activities and student-government updates for the current Ranger Day plan, location and accessible ways to participate.
cards.short_summary: A named Regis programming tradition overseen through student-government activity leadership.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis University’s student-government constitution lists Ranger Day among the on-campus programming and activities led by its vice president of programming.
cards.source_title: Constitution of the Regis University Student Government Association
cards.access_notes: Event timing and activities are not specified in the constitution; consult current Student Activities communications.
